target: Design a deployable workflow for catastrophic forgetting using a sequential-task retention matrix. Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.

competency.title: Design catastrophic forgetting — distribution shift
competency.outcome: Design a deployable workflow for catastrophic forgetting using a sequential-task retention matrix. Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.

topic_kernel.measure: old-task loss after each new task

competency.practice_task: Produce a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget grounded in a sequential-task retention matrix.
competency.setting_constraint: Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.
required_evidence: a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget
Include shift definition and in/out-distribution results.
Report old-task loss after each new task with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: reporting only final-task accuracy.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of catastrophic forgetting.
Practice: an independent reviewer can execute its acceptance tests.
Measurement: report old-task loss after each new task against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for reporting only final-task accuracy; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
